text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—I was able to get good results at the 
Shuka Sho! I'm so happy to write this. 
...Though, honestly, I still couldn't pull 
off that 'dazzling run.'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to become a dazzling 'City Girl' 
that everyone would root for from the 
bottom of their hearts. But... what 
everyone wanted to see was just the 
country bumpkin in me."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"If I hadn't aimed to become a 'City Girl' 
and just stayed as that cute 'Snow Angel,' 
would people still tell me they like me, I 
wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"...This letter somehow turned into 
somethin' real gloomy. I guess I won't 
send it..."
